description: This PHP class, ProjectSearchCriteria, extends SearchCriteria and provides methods to add various filtering criteria for searching projects, such as template status, user access, keywords, client, and archived status.

classes.name: ProjectSearchCriteria
classes.description: A class for building search criteria specific to projects in the system, encapsulating various filters like template status, user permissions, keywords, etc.

methods.name: addTemplateCriterion
methods.description: Adds a criterion to filter projects based on whether they are templates or not.

methods.name: addUserCriterion
methods.description: Adds a criterion to filter projects accessible by a specific user.

methods.name: addKeywordsCriterion
methods.description: Adds a criterion to filter projects based on keywords matching project name or description.

methods.name: addClientCriterion
methods.description: Adds a criterion to filter projects belonging to a specific client.

methods.name: addArchivedCriterion
methods.description: Adds a criterion to filter projects based on their archived status.

methods.name: addIsNotTemplateCriterion
methods.description: Shortcut method to add a criterion for projects that are not templates.

methods.name: addIsTemplateCriterion
methods.description: Shortcut method to add a criterion for projects that are templates.
